keyPoints.hi: and – I like tea and biscuits.

keyPoints.hi: but – He is poor but honest.

keyPoints.en: because / so – I stayed home because I was ill. I was ill, so I stayed home.
keyPoints.hi: because / so – I stayed home because I was ill. I was ill, so I stayed home.

problem.en: Join: "It was raining. We played indoors."
problem.hi: जोड़ो: "It was raining. We played indoors."

steps.en: Raining is the reason; playing indoors is the result → so.
steps.hi: बारिश कारण; अंदर खेलना परिणाम → so।

answer.en: It was raining, so we played indoors.
answer.hi: It was raining, so we played indoors.

problem.en: Fill in: "Would you like milk __ juice?"

steps.en: It gives a choice between two things.
steps.hi: यह दो चीज़ों में विकल्प देता है।

question.en: Fill in: "She was tired __ she finished her work."
question.hi: भरो: "She was tired __ she finished her work."

question.en: Fill in: "He is happy __ he won the race."
question.hi: भरो: "He is happy __ he won the race."

question.en: Join: "I have a cat. I have a dog."
question.hi: जोड़ो: "I have a cat. I have a dog."

answer.en: I have a cat and a dog.
answer.hi: I have a cat and a dog.

intro.en: Conjunctions join words or sentences: and (adds), but (shows contrast), or (gives a choice), because (gives a reason), so (shows a result).
intro.hi: योजक (conjunctions) शब्दों या वाक्यों को जोड़ते हैं: and (जोड़ता है), but (उलटी बात), or (विकल्प), because (कारण), so (परिणाम)।
